title: Legislation considered under suspension of the Rules of the House of Representatives during the week of November 16, 2026
summary_raw: The Majority Leader of the House of Representatives announces bills that will be considered under suspension of the rules in that chamber. CBO estimates the effects of those bills on direct spending and revenues.
